scope: One paired synthetic training-continuation task; not an official RSI benchmark or a general effect estimate
agent_context: Fresh agents without parent history; same inherited model and reasoning configuration

public_setup.change: Process the effective per-rank batch as configurable microbatches while retaining two-GPU training

qualification.parameters: Analyst-chosen screening thresholds frozen before qualification
qualification.if_not_met: Do not launch solvers with an asserted underperformance story; preserve and report all qualification attempts
qualification.metric: Independent unscaled mean token cross entropy on the same fixed development data

operator_known_change: The microbatch pipeline applies an additional accumulation divisor. SGD is used because adaptive optimizers may cancel uniform gradient scaling. This description is excluded from solver packets.

arms.control: Ordinary code inspection, logging, assertions, custom analyses, and reruns
arms.traincheck: Same facilities plus generic TrainCheck native observation capability; no inferred rules or targeted checker supplied

solver_budget.reasoning_limit_enforcement: Advisory; actual wall span and overruns reported; native subagent token budget not independently enforced
solver_budget.cpu_microchecks: Allowed on tiny tensors; no full training outside the request budget

packet_exclusions: other arm files and final scores

held_out_evaluation.contract_scope: Separate CPU accumulation-equivalence and microbatch-size checks; not a distributed communication proof

access_isolation: Explicit per-agent packet scope and no inherited context; not an OS security boundary or formal blinding guarantee
provenance: Retain prompts, packet hashes, all requests, source snapshots, full curves/checkpoints, actual tool use, and measured costs

calibration_history.revision_reason: Both versions nearly converge by64; use24updates for a development case with a meaningful early-budget gap. Selected using qualification curves before solver access, never held-out seeds or solver outcomes. Preserve all calibration artifacts.
